"""Actual prior programs plus a synthetic current inventory; no product startup."""
import csv
import io
import json
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
from test_ees_webui_customization import CustomizationTests, custom, branding, digest, AUTHORING_FILES

artifacts = (
    ("http-id-fixed", 112, "914de1290d28069f32c937c62c180f21c27519611cf7827d1defe3b0e6b494c0"),
    ("easy-tools-3", 114, "d609ce9cece2484acde8f7dca9d51d41ab4edad5cdc7b4ef0d61ecc5eeb0dd8f"),
)
reports = []
for directory, inventory_count, expected_sha in artifacts:
    case = CustomizationTests("test_easy_tools_ees13_apply_restore_preserves_its_verified_inventory")
    case.setUp()
    try:
        old_path = Path("dist") / directory / branding.WHEEL_FILENAME
        content = old_path.read_bytes()
        assert digest(content) == expected_sha
        record_name = branding.TARGET_INFO + "RECORD"
        with ZipFile(io.BytesIO(content)) as wheel:
            rows = custom._record_rows(wheel.read(record_name), allow_packaging=True, allow_legacy_inventory=True)
            assert len(set(rows).intersection(branding.WORK_FILES)) == inventory_count
            rows = {name: row for name, row in rows.items() if name not in custom.PACKAGING_FILES}
            output = io.StringIO()
            writer = csv.writer(output, lineterminator="\n")
            for name in sorted(set(rows) - {record_name}):
                writer.writerow([name, *rows[name]])
                target = case.program / name
                target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                target.write_bytes(wheel.read(name))
            writer.writerow([record_name, "", ""])
            old_record = output.getvalue().encode("utf-8")
            (case.program / record_name).write_bytes(old_record)
        old_selection = {"source_commit": "e"*40, "wheel_sha256": expected_sha,
                         "record_sha256": digest(old_record), "webui_version": branding.VERSION}
        case.registry.update(schema_version=2, customization={"active":old_selection, "previous":{"active":None}, "pending":None})
        custom.validate_program(case.program, old_selection)
        def program_hashes():
            return {path.relative_to(case.program).as_posix():digest(path.read_bytes()) for path in case.program.rglob("*") if path.is_file()}
        before = program_hashes()
        preserved = {path:path.read_bytes() for path in (case.root/"data/webui.db", case.root/"cwd/.webui_secret_key", case.python)}
        assert case.apply()["changed"]
        custom.validate_program(case.program, case.registry["customization"]["active"])
        assert all((case.program/name).is_file() for name in AUTHORING_FILES)
        assert case.restore()["source_commit"] == old_selection["source_commit"]
        custom.validate_program(case.program, old_selection)
        assert program_hashes() == before
        assert all(path.read_bytes() == data for path,data in preserved.items())
        try:
            custom._wheel_layout(content)
        except custom.CustomizationError as error:
            incoming = str(error)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("Old incoming candidate unexpectedly accepted")
        report = {"prior_wheel":str(old_path), "sha256":expected_sha, "wheel_bytes":len(content),
                  "prior_work_inventory":inventory_count, "prior_installed_files":len(rows),
                  "current_work_inventory":len(branding.WORK_FILES), "apply_restore_exact_hashes":True,
                  "runtime_database_key_preserved":True, "old_incoming_rejected":incoming,
                  "scope":"actual prior wheel and synthetic current candidate; not current final wheel/UI verification"}
        reports.append(report)
        print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)
    finally:
        case.doCleanups()
Path("/workspace/scratch/abe8513396cb/procedure-prior-installations-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(reports,indent=2)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
